103.name: Amber

107.name: Tilia
107.profile: "Tilia will always be charging at the forefront, using her shield to protect everyone. Guess only another Imperial Knight might break through her defense."

108.name: Kasimira
108.profile: "Kasimira wields a brutal shotgun. She often puts herself in the line of fire in order to get a hit on her enemies. No matter what, her enemy will fall first."
108.address: Leave a message on the flagpole at the southern entrance of Mirage. I'll find you

110.name: Firenze
110.profile: "Firenze can summon doppelgangers to fight for her on the battlefield. Rumor has it that she does the same in her office, which is how she always manages to stay so graceful."
110.address: Building 6, Xueshi Ave, Gold District, Philae
110.skillsText: Business management, investment actuarial valuation, negotiation and diplomacy, Philae traditional swordsmanship

111.name: Iris
111.profile: "Iris' notebook is filled with magical formulas. Little-trained in close combat, she prefers to use ice to wear down the enemy from a safe distance."

112.name: Noya
112.profile: "Noya uses techniques no one has ever seen, learned from an unknown source. Even skill-casting does not interrupt her long sword's movements."

113.name: Shimiao
113.profile: "In addition to offering long-term on-site support to her companions, Shimiao is also skilled at handling problems herself. Perhaps this is why she embodies the perfect secretary."

113.skillsText: Designing chalkboard displays, creating plans, and overseeing their execution

114.name: Chaton
114.profile: "Chaton is the sniper of White Cat Troupe. Though fond of close combat, in the end she chose a customized weapon as tall as herself, one that can only be used from a distance."
114.weapon: Cat Wand: Uncompleted Codex Entry MK Ⅰ
114.experience: There is literally nothing the great Chaton can't do.

115.name: Firefly
115.profile: "Firefly, who controls transformable armament, is said to be a super weapon secretly developed by Grace Imperium. The firefly-like glow, when gathered in multitude, can become a cannon capable of extreme destruction."
115.address: Room 2707, Building 7, Grace Light Academy Dormitory, Emor City

116.name: Ridge
116.profile: "Ridge is a United Harvest Forester with a habit of stockpiling food. She has a shovel that can fire energy blasts, and she fights alongside the seed plants she scatters on the field."
116.address: United Harvest, Philae City, South Sector, Greenhouse No. 6
116.skillsText: Digging cellars, planting crops, breeding new varieties

117.name: Jinglin
117.profile: "Jinglin can summon lightning and fill the area around her with golden strikes. Though there is no consensus on the origin of this power, Jinglin herself believes that it was granted to her by the Divine Tree in Cang Wu city."

118.name: Coronis
118.profile: "A doctor obsessed with researching strange malady. She wields a scythe, dispenses deadly poisons, and moves through the battlefield with grace."

119.name: Nanoha

120.name: Canace
120.profile: "The legendary "Devil Teacher" as the students called. Her mysterious laurel bracelet can unleashes unexpected effects in battle."

120.skillsText: Teaching, specializing in Grace Energy-related subjects

123.name: Ann

125.name: Freesia

132.name: Minova
